lint.note: Nested-config discovery is off: an .oxlintrc.json under examples/ would otherwise govern its own subtree and void the root ignorePatterns, linting the deliberately broken example sources. Pinned by test/dogfood-config.test.ts.

prose.note: Vale reads no .gitignore and skips no hidden directory, so the shipped default path `.` would sweep .plumbbob/, .claude/, dist/ and friends; these paths are this repo's linted prose surface. Pinned by test/dogfood-config.test.ts, which also asserts every tracked .md outside a known-excluded set is reachable from them.

typecheck-tests.note: tsconfig.json is the published build and excludes tests, so they would otherwise never be type-checked.

attw.note: esm-only profile: this package ships ESM only, and its Node >=22 engines range can require() it.
